hard: Fresh canonical anchors must remain exact where applicable: repository identity, canonical main SHA, current planning/semantic subject, effective NEXT or explicit conflict, exact TASK/correction/review subject, exact lineage/CAS, Unified State lifecycle state and next_action, authority, current blockers, current Human decisions/risk acceptance and valid task-scoped delegation, selected Flow Card identity and current Human request.

The context pipeline order is fixed semantically: fresh canonical anchors -> deterministic relevance projection -> rule-based elision -> exact digest-bound reuse -> deterministic context-budget evaluation -> bounded summarization only when still over budget -> exact expansion when a semantic decision depends on compressed material -> Brain reasoning.

Deterministic relevance may use only closed versioned inputs such as selected Flow Card, lifecycle state, next_action, exact subject identity/type, Flow Card required/optional context rules, canonical blocker/conflict state, explicit Human-selected side flow and current request class. No model-driven relevance selection is permitted.

Control facts are non-elidable. Human intent/priority/risk acceptance, effective NEXT, active blockers/conflicts, exact TASK/correction/review subject, currently decisive acceptance/modification scope, active failed RUN or review finding, exact lineage/CAS, authority/next_action and active task-scoped delegation when applicable must remain exact.

Elision must be rule-based, closed, versioned and provenance-preserving. Resolved history, unrelated lineages, duplicate compatibility views, superseded state and non-required operational metadata may be omitted only under explicit deterministic rules; ambiguity expands exact context or fails closed.

Digest reuse is a disposable derived optimization with no authority. Reuse must bind exact repository/source identity, source digest, structural selector, Flow Card digest/version, projection-rule version and context-pipeline version as applicable. Any required binding movement invalidates reuse. Deleting all derived reuse material may change cost only, never semantic behavior.

A summary may exist only as an overflow representation after deterministic projection/elision/reuse still exceeds the declared context budget. Summary material cannot establish NEXT, authority, risk, scope, lineage, correction eligibility, review verdict or publication eligibility.

If a final semantic decision depends on material represented only by summary, digest-only reuse or an elision manifest, the exact bounded canonical source must be expanded and rebound before the decision can be finalized; uncertainty must not be converted into an answer.

Roadmap projection must expose one mechanically provable effective NEXT or an explicit conflict. next_items, sequence status, blockers, return metadata or Human-priority compatibility mirrors cannot independently win. The TASK-319 split-brain shape must fail closed.

A unique unauthored roadmap NEXT is valid planning state and must remain distinguishable from ambiguous/multiple NEXT. It must resolve to TASK_AUTHORING rather than be treated as a selected executable TASK.

BrainWorkContext and flow resolution must consume the compiled bounded context rather than default-hydrating unbounded planning/spec/history material. Flow Cards remain context contracts, not semantic routers.

All composition/projection/reuse/budget operations remain observation-only and must not create RUNs, invoke an Executor, execute verification, mutate roadmap/lifecycle state or create a second canonical state store.
Executor modifies only scope.modify. If a required production mutation falls outside that set, fail closed for Brain scope reconciliation rather than widening implementation authority.

Implementation must start from exact admitted TASK-321 canonical lineage on then-current main and publication must use normal Runtime/Reviewer/Publisher boundaries. Never use TASK-320 author/review refs or a stale local branch as main-equivalent; never force publication.

task.problem: Current canonical BO-2/3 planning requires one context pipeline rather than separate roadmap-projection and Brain-Sync optimizations. The published Brain Sync/Brain Context path is not yet sufficient for that exit: BrainSyncSnapshot still exposes a general snapshot and BrainWorkContext copies that observation wholesale; relevance is not yet compiled as a closed Flow-Card-derived projection; rule-based elision, disposable digest-bound reuse, deterministic context-budget handling and exact expansion before summary-dependent decisions are not implemented as one contract. The live Brain Sync regression also assumes the unique NEXT is already an authored TASK, while the current canonical roadmap intentionally exposes one unique unauthored BO-2/3 NEXT and must route that state to TASK_AUTHORING without treating it as roadmap ambiguity. Implement the combined BO-2/3 architecture without creating a semantic router, memory system or second roadmap authority.
